exact_binding_rules: A3 and A4 page_id must match when both are present
A3 request/response artifacts are normalized only from resolved evidence payloads
A3 raw response body is never required; redacted response body evidence is accepted
A4 fields, locator candidates, repeated regions and highest-confidence pagination candidate are retained
command_id is supplied by the caller and retained as provenance
action_id is retained from A3 evidence; multiple action ids remain an ordered list; missing remains UNKNOWN
page_id is retained from exact A3/A4 receipts
evidence pointers are copied without rewriting authority
